data.desc: KULR Technology Group, Inc. (NYSE American: KULR) is an energy systems company serving physical AI and other mission-critical applications. Its KULR ONE Air and KULR ONE Space battery systems, built in Webster, Texas, serve autonomous systems and space customers. Its KULR ONE Max energy storage systems serve power-as-a-service deployments. Each business draws on KULR's battery safety, thermal management, battery management and monitoring technology.
